svg.title: Junior Forest Warden / Canadian Forestry Assn.
svg.desc: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The embossed maple leaf and condensed lettering are interpreted as clean forms; leather grain is deliberately absent.
